        "The complete three-file owned diff is read. Credentials now carry an EWS URL and add NTLM; validate performs preflight checks; to_auth_header_value returns Option and maps OAuth aborts to authentication errors; the client extracts a retry/cancel helper; and request header/body setters become by-value builder methods. No changed tests are present.",
        "On a401 with ReAuth enabled, the client first tries the full NTLM negotiation with existing credentials, interpreting success as permission to retry the original SOAP request. If renewal fails, it prompts, refetches server credentials, replaces the client snapshot and validates on RETRY. Invalid loops back to prompting, ABORT returns Break, and other errors propagate. A renewed cookie or successful operation is not inspected here.",
        "Basic/OAuth validation makes a small authenticated GET and treats only401 as Invalid; every other status is Valid. NTLM uses the standalone helper's matching non-401 boundary. Thus validation does not establish a successful SOAP response, general HTTP success or cookie persistence. No retry cap is added in this handler.",
        "The header Option is functional: NTLM returns None so normal SOAP requests omit Authorization; Basic always formats username:password, including an empty password after removal of the prior guard; OAuth returns Some(Bearer) or an authentication error on abort. Accepted source later delegates Basic and NTLM to Necko, so historical Basic and manual-cookie rules must not be taught as current behavior.",
        "The current RequestBuilder still consumes and returns itself from header/body. Conditional header setup therefore reassigns the builder before the remaining chain. The checked accepted sender also consumes an optional provider value. Its nearby comment mentions Basic, while the actual provider branch delegates Basic to Necko; the implementation controls this scoped contract.",
        "The owned retry helper permits a RefCell borrow across await with a local explanation and Clippy allowance. That explanation is not a proof of all async interleavings. Checked incoming and outgoing factories construct new clients from credentials; no same-instance concurrent caller or RefCell panic is established. Authentication/frontend concurrency caveats in review remain historical limits.",
        "Incoming URL lookup uses GetStringValue(ews_url); outgoing lookup reads mail.outgoingserver.<key>.ews_url with the documented trailing period in the branch. Client credential replacement is a local snapshot update, not a demonstrated refresh of every connection-details snapshot or future client. Broader architecture is bounded.",
        "Naming separates AuthValidationOutcome from NTLMAuthOutcome and ControlFlow from operation success. The extracted helper makes retry/cancel handling clearer, but retains nested match/loop logic. A local lint suppression and historical approval do not replace the caller check or establish a general borrow-across-await rule.",
        "Original Bug1995024 full current0–5/end is reused by exact ID; part2 helper and part3 client integration remain separate owned commits. No duplicate raw capture or new independent confirmation.",
